title: Restic backup definition
description: Backup definitions for the standalone Invoke-Backup.ps1 restic script. One 'backups' entry produces one restic snapshot containing all of its paths. Paths and the repository use %VAR% environment variable syntax, expanded repeatedly so a variable pointing at another variable resolves.

repository.description: Restic repository, passed as --repo. Either a local path or a restic backend URL (sftp:, s3:, rest:, b2:, rclone: ...), which is why it is not held to the stricter path rule. Supports %VAR% expansion.

tags.description: Tags added to every snapshot. May be omitted or empty.

backups.description: Backup definitions. Each entry is one restic snapshot.

name.description: Backup name. Selects the backup on the command line and is added as a snapshot tag, so it has to be tag-safe.

tags.description: Tags added to this snapshot on top of the global ones. May be omitted or empty.

paths.description: Files or folders to back up, passed to restic as backup targets. Supports %VAR% expansion. To keep a single file out of a large folder, name the file itself instead of its folder.

exclude.description: Restic exclude patterns applied to every path of this backup, passed as --exclude. These are globs rather than paths, so they are only checked for being non-blank.
